title: waƙar duwatsu da magariba
intro: Ku saurara yayin da kwaruruka ke rera waƙa tare da wani bawan Allah da aka zaɓa. Murya mai baiwa da waƙa, hukunci da masu jayayya ke nema a ɗakin, da ƙarfe da aka sassauta da umarnin Allah suna jiran a gano. Wace siffar bauta da adalci ce ke magana ta waɗannan alamu?
clues: Allah ya albarkace ni da falala da kuma muryar yabo mai daɗi.
Allah ya koya min fahimtar harshen adalci tsakanin masu jayayya.
Na fuskanci wani babban jarumi a yaƙi kuma da yardar Allah na yi nasara a kansu.
An ba ni hikima, iko da kuma littafin zabura da aka saukar daga Allah.
Duwatsu da tsuntsaye sun haɗu da ni suna tasbihi tare da ni da yamma da kuma fitowar rana.
Allah ya koya min yadda ake yin riguna na ƙarfe da aka yi da ƙarfe wanda aka yi mini laushi.

trial.label: Gwaji/Taron
options: Ya kayar da Jalut (Goliath) a yaƙi da yardar Allah
Gina Jirgin Ruwa domin ya tsira daga babban ambaliyar ruwa
An jefa shi cikin wuta wanda Allah ya sanyaya ta
Babban kifi a cikin teku ya haɗiye shi
An ɗaga shi zuwa sama ba tare da ya ɗanɗana mutuwa ba
trial.answer: Ya kayar da Jalut (Goliath) a yaƙi da yardar Allah

location.label: Babban Sinadari
options: Duwatsu da tsuntsaye suna haɗuwa don yabon Allah
Sanda da ta rikide ta zama maciji
Wutar da ta zama mai sanyi da kwanciyar hankali
Raƙumi da aka aika a matsayin alama ga mutane
Akwatin katako da ke kan Dutsen Judi
location.answer: Duwatsu da tsuntsaye suna haɗuwa don yabon Allah

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: An ba shi sarauta, hikima, da kuma Zabur (Zabura)
An ba wa ɗa bayan ya tsufa bayan addu'a mai ƙarfi
An ba da aminci a cikin kogo na tsawon shekaru masu yawa
An ba da maɓuɓɓugar Zamzam a cikin hamada
An ba da izinin nutsar da rundunar a cikin teku
outcome.answer: An ba shi sarauta, hikima, da kuma Zabur (Zabura)

arabic: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
verse: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allāh] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise. (38:18)
